title.text: workharbor: web UI and whr CLI mock, with example data

history.text: Chats grow large. Purge transcript removes messages, tool output and diffs; audit entries and a record of the purge stay. Clear view only hides older events.

phone.text: Phone: decisions first, chat and approvals on one screen. Installable PWA in release 1; the phone chat reaches the same live session.

cli.text: Every action in the web UI has a whr command. Exit code 6 means a task needs human input.

push.text: ntfy push: task ID, event kind and a link only. Never issue text or code, and no approve button. Approvals stay behind your login.

v0.text: In v0 the web UI is a remote for the agent: live chat, send, start, pause, resume, cancel, decisions and approvals. After v0: open in editor and takeover.

login.text: auth_expired is a blocking Decision. The run pauses, the workspace and session are kept, and you log in again from the UI.

onboarding.text: First-run wizard: sign in, forge, agents and default mode, host checks (untested items are marked), ntfy.
